dataset.name: Mount Sinai primary melanoma cohort (GSE98394)
dataset.description: Independent treatment-naive primary cutaneous-melanoma cohort with bulk RNA sequencing and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The discovery series contains 51 primary skin melanomas and 27 benign nevi. TRACE Explorer excludes every nevus before endpoint QC and retains the 44 primary melanomas with positive overall-survival time and a recognized vital status. Seven additional primary melanomas lack a public endpoint and are not exposed.

metadata.source_program: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai primary-melanoma discovery cohort
metadata.library_method: Ribosomal-RNA-depleted paired-end bulk RNA-seq aligned with STAR to Ensembl build 37 and quantified at gene level with Rsubread featureCounts
metadata.endpoint_context: Overall survival in treatment-naive patients with primary cutaneous melanoma
metadata.endpoint_caveat: GEO supplies time to death or last follow-up and vital status, but the exact calendar origin is not stated. TRACE Explorer therefore labels this as source-provided OS and preserves that uncertainty.
metadata.sample_selection_note: Tissue type is applied before endpoint and expression QC. All 27 benign nevi are excluded, as are seven primary melanomas whose GEO records do not contain both a usable OS time and vital status.
metadata.annotation_caveat: The publication identifies Ensembl build 37 but not the exact release. TRACE Explorer pins the final canonical GRCh37 Ensembl release 75 to map stable Ensembl gene identifiers deterministically; unmapped repetitive-element rows remain excluded.
metadata.overlap_note: The study collected an independent treatment-naive primary-melanoma series and is not derived from TCGA-SKCM or the metastatic immunotherapy cohorts already in the catalog.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the public GEO files in place. Source-file redistribution is disabled; NCBI GEO terms remain controlling.

expression.label: GEO featureCounts normalized to log2(CPM + 1)
expression.source_unit: Rsubread featureCounts gene and repetitive-element raw counts
expression.mapping_source: Pinned Ensembl release 75 GRCh37 gene_name annotation
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Only rows that map uniquely to a gene symbol are analyzable; unmapped repetitive-element rows and symbols represented by multiple Ensembl rows are excluded.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer computes library size over all 24,505 source rows, converts counts to CPM, applies log2(CPM + 1), maps build-37 Ensembl IDs and excludes ambiguous symbols. The resulting values are intended for within-cohort analysis.

endpoints.label: Source-provided overall survival
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause; living patients are censored at the source-provided last follow-up
